% Pattern: environment/proof/article. A proof environment of the paper that
% prints its argument as the head, as \begin{proofof}{Proof of Theorem
% \protect{\ref{a}}}, proves the item that the argument names.
% seen in the gold pilot (set E)
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1 status=here
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 2 status=here
% want proofof-1 proof - proves=theorem-1
% want proofof-2 proof - proves=lemma-1
\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\newenvironment{proofof}[1]{\noindent {\bf #1.\/}}{\qed\vskip 0.1in}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem}\label{a} Each set is small. \end{theorem}
\begin{lemma}\label{b} Each small set is finite. \end{lemma}
\begin{proofof}{\it Proof of Theorem \protect{\ref{a}}}
A set is a union of points.
\end{proofof}
\begin{proofof}{\it Proof of Lemma \protect{\ref{b}}}
A small set has few points.
\end{proofof}
\end{document}
